title: Image + prompt → laser art variants
description: Generate a master image, then prepare grayscale/dither, limited-palette, and vector variants in parallel.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: laser-art-production
  title: Image + prompt → laser art variants
  description: Generate a master image from a reference and prompt, then prepare grayscale/dither,
    limited-palette, and vector variants in parallel.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce a generated master image and three reproducible, fabrication-oriented laser-art variants.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 3
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor: []
  nodes:
    - id: source
      kind: input
      name: Image + art prompt
      summary: A host-provided reference image, generation prompt, and optional laser-processing settings.
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [asset, instructions]
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: image/*
            description: A host-provided data URL, local file reference, uploaded-asset identifier, or authorized
              HTTPS URL. Ladder Graph does not upload or fetch the asset.
          instructions:
            type: string
            description: The prompt for the generated master and any invariants that must be preserved.
          material:
            type: string
            description: Optional target material, such as wood, acrylic, anodized aluminum, paper, or slate.
          physicalSize:
            type: object
            properties:
              widthMm: { type: number, exclusiveMinimum: 0 }
              heightMm: { type: number, exclusiveMinimum: 0 }
          resolutionDpi: { type: number, exclusiveMinimum: 0 }
          dither:
            type: object
            properties:
              method:
                type: string
                enum: [floyd-steinberg, jarvis-judice-ninke, stucki, atkinson, ordered, threshold]
              threshold: { type: number, minimum: 0, maximum: 255 }
              invert: { type: boolean }
          palette:
            type: array
            minItems: 2
            items:
              type: object
              required: [name, color]
              properties:
                name: { type: string }
                color: { type: string, pattern: "^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$" }
                operation: { type: string }
          vector:
            type: object
            properties:
              threshold: { type: number, minimum: 0, maximum: 255 }
              minimumFeatureMm: { type: number, minimum: 0 }
              simplifyToleranceMm: { type: number, minimum: 0 }
              kerfMm: { type: number, minimum: 0 }
        x-ladder-input-mode: image
      position: { x: 80, y: 260 }
    - id: generate-master
      kind: agent
      templateRef: laser-01
      name: Generate master image
      summary: Use the reference and prompt to create a high-resolution master suited to downstream processing.
      role: Laser-art image generation specialist
      prompt: Generate a new master image from the supplied image and prompt. Preserve requested subjects and
        composition, favor clear silhouettes and separable tonal regions that survive laser processing, avoid
        unsupported text or detail, and return the image with the effective prompt, dimensions, model parameters,
        rights context, and provenance.
      capabilities:
        skills: [image-understanding, product-design, rights-provenance]
        tools: [read, generate-media]
        connectors: [api:image-model]
        permissions: [external-write]
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [asset, mediaType, effectivePrompt, dimensions, provenance]
        properties:
          asset: { type: string }
          mediaType: { type: string, pattern: "^image/" }
          effectivePrompt: { type: string }
          dimensions: { type: object }
          parameters: { type: object }
          provenance: { type: object }
          processingSettings: { type: object }
      position: { x: 370, y: 260 }
    - id: grayscale-dither
      kind: agent
      templateRef: laser-02
      name: Grayscale + dither
      summary: Produce continuous-tone grayscale and machine-resolution dithered raster variants.
      role: Laser raster and dithering specialist
      prompt: Convert the generated master to a laser-ready grayscale raster and a dithered variant. Respect the
        requested material, machine resolution, physical size, tone curve, threshold, inversion, and dither method;
        preserve edges and recognizable structure; and return lossless previews plus every reproducibility parameter.
      capabilities:
        skills: [image-understanding, implementation, evaluation]
        tools: [read, render]
        connectors: []
        permissions: [external-write]
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [grayscaleAsset, ditheredAsset, mediaType, parameters]
        properties:
          grayscaleAsset: { type: string }
          ditheredAsset: { type: string }
          mediaType: { type: string, enum: [image/png] }
          parameters: { type: object }
          warnings: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
      position: { x: 700, y: 40 }
    - id: palette-quantize
      kind: agent
      templateRef: laser-03
      name: Quantize palette
      summary: Reduce the master to a named palette mapped to laser operations or material layers.
      role: Laser palette quantization specialist
      prompt: Quantize the generated master to the requested named color palette without inventing colors. Preserve
        important boundaries, map each palette color to its intended laser operation or material, report color counts
        and conversion error, and return an indexed lossless image, a visual preview, and reproducibility parameters.
      capabilities:
        skills: [image-understanding, quantitative-analysis, evaluation]
        tools: [read, calculate, render]
        connectors: []
        permissions: [external-write]
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [asset, preview, mediaType, paletteMap, parameters]
        properties:
          asset: { type: string }
          preview: { type: string }
          mediaType: { type: string, enum: [image/png] }
          paletteMap: { type: array, items: { type: object } }
          colorCounts: { type: object }
          conversionError: { type: number, minimum: 0 }
          parameters: { type: object }
          warnings: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
      position: { x: 700, y: 260 }
    - id: vectorize
      kind: agent
      templateRef: laser-04
      name: Vectorize artwork
      summary: Trace the master into clean SVG paths and provide a raster preview.
      role: Laser vector tracing specialist
      prompt: Trace the generated master into clean fabrication-oriented vector paths. Respect physical dimensions,
        minimum feature size, threshold, smoothing, corner preservation, path simplification, fill-versus-stroke
        intent, kerf notes, and layer naming; remove specks and open paths unless explicitly required; and return SVG,
        a raster preview, path statistics, and reproducibility parameters.
      capabilities:
        skills: [image-understanding, implementation, evaluation]
        tools: [read, render]
        connectors: []
        permissions: [external-write]
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [asset, preview, mediaType, dimensions, pathStats, parameters]
        properties:
          asset: { type: string }
          preview: { type: string }
          mediaType: { type: string, enum: [image/svg+xml] }
          dimensions: { type: object }
          pathStats: { type: object }
          parameters: { type: object }
          warnings: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
      position: { x: 700, y: 480 }
    - id: variants
      kind: aggregator
      name: Collect laser variants
      summary: Preserve all completed branch outputs and their parameters as one keyed package.
      config:
        aggregation: collect
      position: { x: 1050, y: 260 }
    - id: output
      kind: output
      name: Laser art package
      summary: Return the generated master, raster variants, quantized artwork, SVG, previews, and provenance.
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [master, grayscaleAndDither, quantized, vector]
        properties:
          master: { type: object }
          grayscaleAndDither: { type: object }
          quantized: { type: object }
          vector: { type: object }
      position: { x: 1330, y: 260 }
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: source, to: generate-master, kind: data, contract: LaserArtRequest }
    - { id: e2, from: generate-master, to: grayscale-dither, kind: data, contract: GeneratedMasterImage }
    - { id: e3, from: generate-master, to: palette-quantize, kind: data, contract: GeneratedMasterImage }
    - { id: e4, from: generate-master, to: vectorize, kind: data, contract: GeneratedMasterImage }
    - { id: e5, from: grayscale-dither, to: variants, kind: data, contract: DitheredRasterVariant }
    - { id: e6, from: palette-quantize, to: variants, kind: data, contract: QuantizedPaletteVariant }
    - { id: e7, from: vectorize, to: variants, kind: data, contract: VectorizedVariant }
    - { id: e8, from: generate-master, to: output, kind: data, contract: GeneratedMasterImage }
    - { id: e9, from: variants, to: output, kind: data, contract: LaserVariantCollection }
